must_fix.problem: The question embeds a physical component-replacement claim: the factory cloth filter had been replaced. The selected originals establish a cloth-clogging problem and cyclone dust separation; they do not say that the cloth filter was physically removed/replaced. SENRA explicitly describes taking off/replacing the domestic bag in a later event, which cannot be projected back onto the factory filter.

sources.quote: We were sucking it away onto a cloth filter, a huge cloth filter, which clogged all the time.
we built at the factory to stop the cloth from getting clogged with dust. Instead, we were spinning it out successfully by centrifugal force.
building a 25ft cyclone to suck the waste powder away
I took the bag off my upright vacuum cleaner, replaced it with a bit of hose and this cardboard mini version

rows.text: 你只靠四個工程人員，要把新吸塵器交出去，誰來組裝？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 九〇年代初，戴森決定自己製造。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他回憶，自己和三名工程師，替全部零件畫圖，再去找承包商和模具商。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 可是，組裝這一步，他們沒找到人承接。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 我想知道，山本手上那個孔罩，之前又是為哪個入口的麻煩做的？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 而量產模具的錢，又得由誰去向銀行爭取？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 今天跟著戴森，走完一台無袋原型到英國初期接貨的路。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 不用集塵袋的想法，中間還要換過多少人的手，才能做成能賣的機器？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 開場那台無袋吸塵器的原理，是從戴森處理的一個工廠故障接過來的。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 公司官網把時間記在一九七八年：他在工廠替金屬架噴粉。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 很多粉末沒有留在架子上，抽走餘粉時，又把後面的一大片布濾堵住。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 換成你要讓生產繼續，我也會問：要把粉末收住，該換哪一種裝置？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 官網還記下，他去看過木材廠的大型氣旋，想把那種分離方式用回工廠。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 戴森回憶，問到工業氣旋的報價，他們負擔不起，於是花幾個週末自行製作。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他說，做出的裝置很大，頂端構造要穿出屋頂，還得在廠房開孔。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 這一次，粉末先從空氣裡分離，不再全靠那片布接住。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 我在意的不是它有多高，而是堵住的地方，讓人換了一種收集辦法。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 那麼，這個辦法，能不能縮進你家裡那台吸塵器？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 戴森說，有一次在家清掃，機器顯示集塵袋堵了，他卻找不到替換袋。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 於是他把袋子倒空，用膠帶封回去，再裝上試。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 袋子裡沒東西了，機器還是吸不動。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 你大概也會懷疑，問題真在袋子裝滿嗎？我想再問，倒空後，袋裡還留著什麼？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 他重新打開袋子，看見內壁覆著一層細灰。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 依他的解釋，空氣必須穿過袋上的氣孔，細灰卻把這些出口堵住了。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他買了新袋換上，吸力短暫恢復，之後又往下掉。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 工廠曾換掉布濾，他在家要先做出什麼，才能試同一個想法？
rows.note: MF-R4-01: historical premise says factory cloth filter was replaced; source establishes cyclone separation, not physical removal.

rows.text: 他用紙板和膠帶做了小氣旋，再用一段軟管，接到原來的直立式吸塵器上。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 原本放袋子的地方，換成這個小模型，他推著機器試用。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 這只是把分離方式接上舊機驗證，離能賣的完整產品，還有別的工作。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 要繼續改形狀，沒錢買大型機床，模型又怎麼做？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 戴森回憶，自己在家工作，買不起車床等設備，就用小工具動手。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他從舊物店找到金屬滾輪，把材料滾成倒錐形，再焊接起來。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 工具讓他能把下一個形狀做成實物，拿去試，然後再決定怎麼改。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 但如果一次改了好幾處，你怎麼知道，哪一項真的有用？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 他在另一段訪談裡解釋，試作時一次只改一項，等著看差異。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 可能變好，也可能變差；看懂這次發生什麼，才決定下一個模型要怎麼做。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 開放大學的訪談研究，也記錄了他製作、測試黃銅、鋁與透明塑料模型。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 我覺得關鍵在這裡：模型不是擺在架上算數，而是拿來排除一個不知道的地方。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 能做出工作樣機以後，誰來付模具的錢、把它批量做出來？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 戴森回憶，他和合作夥伴原先選擇，把工作放在發明、工程與樣機上。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 兩人都做過製造，這次希望由取得授權的廠商接下生產。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 那份訪談研究也指出，這種吸塵器的模具支出，是商品化要跨過的一關。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 真的有人接下授權，把後面的生產做出來了嗎？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 後來，英國一家取得授權的廠商，確實做出Cyclon。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 戴森把生產列在一九八三、八四年，並說一共只做五百五十台，商業上沒有成功。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 科學博物館群所藏的一台，標明在義大利製造，為英國的授權商生產。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 日本之前已經有商品；Apex這次，又是怎麼找到戴森的？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 在這段時期，日本Apex社長看見一本設計書上的照片，便聯絡戴森。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 山本秀夫在後來的贊助訪談裡說，那是美國一九八四年出版的書。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 戴森帶著一台樣品來到日本，社長原想進口成品，拿到的卻尚未完成。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 換成你要進貨，我想你也會問：現在接的是產品，還是一筆開發工作？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 在山本的敘述裡，談判改成在日本重新製作，再由戴森交出當地銷售權。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 山本說，Apex本業是進口文具，沒有自家的工程師和工廠。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 社長負責設法找工廠，開發工作，則交給剛轉職的山本。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 山本自己的工作室履歷，把加入Apex列在一九八五年，參與英國團隊的共同開發。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 工廠找到了，現場就有人做過這種吸塵器嗎？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 依山本回憶，承製者原本做精密機械，並不專門做吸塵器。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他自己以前，也沒有設計吸塵器的經驗。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 我覺得，接下來的難處是讓這些人的手接上，不是把樣品交出去就等交貨。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 你如果想直接沿用原設計，哪個規格差異會先讓人停下來？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 山本說，英國和日本的電壓不同，他們得重新找馬達。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 要找一百伏特、輸出相近的馬達，結果尺寸比原先大。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 為了把它裝進去，外殼配置也必須重新檢視。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 如果我是接案的人，會先問：這樣重做，多久才有第一台能試的機器？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 依山本多年後的粗略估計，第一台日本試作品，大約花了半年。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 可是，裝得起來，放到地毯上推，又會發生什麼事？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 他回憶，那個馬達很重。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 機器會吸住地毯，難以前進。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 硬往前推，還曾把輪子推裂。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 你大概想問，除了移動，試作還出了哪些狀況？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 他也提到雜物堵塞、馬達過熱，甚至使外殼熔損的狀況。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他估計，第一台試作之後，另有約一年半，都在處理陸續出現的問題。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 山本還指出槽內一個入口，那裡有他參與設計的部件。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 這個入口，是把外圍的氣流帶往哪裡？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 他描述的路徑，是氣流沿著槽外圍轉，再進到內側的錐體。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 開場那個孔罩，山本說，是加在氣流進入錐體的入口，避免雜物堵在那裡。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 要讓雜物繼續在外圍轉動，空氣則經過入口往內走。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 加了這個部件，接著要調整的是什麼？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 山本說，他們試驗不同大小、不同形狀的孔，靠這些實驗解決那個入口的堵塞問題。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 孔要改，另一端設計的人，也得知道日本這邊試到了哪裡。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 戴森回英國時，這些設計要怎麼繼續接下去？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 山本說，戴森人在英國時，他們就一再傳真往返。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 訪談展示的圖紙和傳真頁，還留下這些合作文件。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 你改完這一端，另一端還得接著做；我看到的，是一份要反覆往返的工作。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 圖面要完成，問題也要有人接手，約定裡由誰負責？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 依山本回憶，戴森負有解決問題、完成圖面的責任。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 除了傳真，他本人有沒有到日本一起做？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 山本說，為了走到能販售的階段，戴森曾數度來日本。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 每次停留，大約是一到兩週。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 兩人一起到工廠、畫圖，也一起做實驗。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 你想看他具體動手改什麼，一張官網照片，留下了哪個工作？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 圖說記為一九八五年東京西麻布，正在重設後來G-Force的吸頭。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 戴森在後來口述裡，把與Apex達成授權協議放在一九八六年。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 這和前一年的改圖，是不同記錄，不能併成一個精確簽約日。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 山本訪談把日本G-Force的發售，也記在一九八六年。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 你會以為能上架就會大賣嗎？我想問，這回究竟是多大一門生意？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 戴森在二〇一七年的口述裡，稱它是小眾商品，每台約二十五萬日圓。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他說，Apex賣這台機器，沒有取得很大的商業成功。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 但授權合作，確實開始替他帶來收入。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 要走到開場那批零件圖，還差自家製造需要的資金和場地。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 收入進來了，量產模具的錢，就一定借得到嗎？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 開場問的模具款，戴森回憶，一位到企業訪問的銀行人員，替他爭取貸款。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他說，對方的請求先被銀行拒絕，又去找銀行內部的申訴角色，爭取批准。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他自己拿房屋作擔保，太太也得在相關表格上簽名。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 如果換成你，要押上住的房子，我會先看清楚，哪一筆風險落在自己身上。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 錢能買模具，開場卻還缺組裝的人；這件事，要先找到哪一個落腳處？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 開場那四個人，從成型供應商那裡找到一個機會：對方的工廠，有半邊閒著。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 他提出把閒置的半邊租下來，用來組裝，就不必先買一整座廠房。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 但模具仍得自己投資，租到空間，沒有把這筆支出一起省掉。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 那麼，空間有了，誰安排組裝線，誰實際上線做？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 他回憶，最初沒有另外設置生產經理和品管專員，只有那個工程團隊。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 開場問的組裝，最後還得另外聘線長，再聘真正上線組裝的工人。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 公司另有一張標作一九九三年的產線照，留下的是哪個現場？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 那張照片的地點，是英國奇彭納姆的邦帕斯農場。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 多台機器排在線上，有人在工作，旁邊也有紙箱。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 租下的半廠在哪裡，那段訪談沒有交代，不能把兩份記錄當成同一間廠房。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 可是，有了能交的機器，你就一定找得到店家接貨嗎？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 戴森記得，面對一名郵購目錄買手時，對方先懷疑配套的乾粉地毯清潔法。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 他去加油站買黑醋栗飲料，回來倒在地毯上，再撒上乾洗粉。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 然後才用機器吸除。依他的回憶，這場示範成功了。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 要看清楚，他示範的是先用配套乾洗粉，不是宣稱機器能直接濕吸飲料。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 可買手看完，為什麼仍然沒有立刻點頭？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 他還得面對另一個疑問：目錄裡已有知名品牌，為什麼要換成這台陌生產品？
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 他回憶，買手最後答應先試一試，成了第一家備貨的郵購目錄。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 換成你要騰出目錄的位置，我想你也不會只問能不能吸，還會問能不能賣。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 在另一段口述裡，戴森記下，後來又有第二家郵購目錄，再接到約翰路易斯百貨。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 走進店面以後，使用者能看見的灰塵，店家又願不願意展示？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 英國智慧財產局的一份決定書，記下他說，不少潛在零售商不喜歡透明集塵筒。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 但他認為，顧客能看見灰塵的位置、理解運作，也能看見清掃的效果。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 依這份證詞，他仍選擇保留透明設計。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 我想，買手聽過一次示範，店裡的你卻未必聽過；誰來把差別說清楚？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 戴森回憶，他得爭取零售商同意，在機器旁擺上技術和差異的說明資料。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 他想讓買家不只比較折扣和價格，也看性能、耐用和使用方式。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 但如果通路還要求廣告支持，手邊又沒有現成預算，條件怎麼談？
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 談英國初期通路的另一段回憶裡，戴森說，曾有電器零售商要求廣告支持。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 他當時沒錢做廣告，便提議按店家的訂購量，投入約定的電視廣告。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 戴森說，雙方是按這個條件達成交易。
rows.note: Checked current narration against original source context and role.

rows.text: 我對開場問題的答案是：無袋原型解了一段堵塞，交到顧客手上，還得有人接完製造和接貨的工作。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim. Official auto transcript is not fully corrected; no certified exact original words/counts/dates or independently listened audio claimed.

rows.text: 如果換成你接案，哪一步沒完成，你就不敢把產品交出去？留言告訴我。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.

rows.text: 想看日用品怎麼跨過這些實際難關，就訂閱品牌故事。
rows.note: Question, reaction, connection or CTA read for factual premises; no additional unsupported historical claim.
